scope: Current reviewed slice and nine planned packets; no new runtime geometry

contract.runtime: One compiled scene and collision owner per building; never one duplicate building per frontage.
contract.authoring: EV-000 exact face and mass owners stay authoritative. Runtime partitions cannot authorize edits.
contract.initialGrowth: P01 may add only its four buildings and observed faces through a bounded adapter, initially retained with existing context. Exact catalog/face assertions must extend by that explicit set; preserve current 203 hashes unless separately assigned.
contract.newSpatialArea: Before another releasable group: generalize readiness over explicit manifest groups; full visual AABB, car/camera/resize coverage, predictive requests, collision ownership and request cancellation must use the same group. No blind copies of global street/prop builders.
contract.route: Keep current origin shift; separately extend street/void/collision/address/minimap bounds only as needed by the assigned packet. Municipal roads are not automatically drivable.
contract.gates: Inspect every new business; rerun affected browser routes and measured startup/frame/resource budget after growth. The 12/191 proof does not establish full-area capacity.
